memoryReview.lesson: The geographic field and contextual orders differ from a literal editable culture; retain square simulation cells and an explicit tool bench.
The restoration modal and paper illustration should not become a template for this permanently available cell editor.
First-person depth and perimeter combat controls do not serve a discrete learning experiment.
Missing capture prevents a reliable image comparison; do not infer quality from the project name.
Missing capture is recorded honestly; the existing architectural profile is a full-bleed first-person world.

references.observation: The page places evolving cells and simulation rules around a cell field that remains the main object.
references.principle: Keep simulation state visible in a literal cell representation.
references.application: Preserve the source grid as the entire editable environment.
references.avoid: Do not copy cellular birth and death rules into reinforcement learning.

references.observation: Movable start and goal objects turn grid traversal into a directly editable experiment.
references.principle: The same spatial diagram should explain and accept user input.
references.application: Retain draggable start and goal and immediate obstacle painting.
references.avoid: Do not imply that the Q-learning agent runs the A-star algorithm.

references.observation: The article exposes evolving cellular states as experiments with observable intermediate results.
references.principle: Let users inspect intermediate simulation steps rather than only final outcomes.
references.application: Keep separate single-step, run and reset operations with numeric rewards.
references.avoid: Do not present this simple tabular learner as a neural cellular automaton.

concepts.medium: Source Canvas 2D pigment cells and an authored vector dish icon.
concepts.composition: A complete rectangular culture under a permanent wrapping instrument strip.
concepts.interaction: Direct cell painting with draggable experiment endpoints and discrete stepping.
concepts.motion: Cell state snaps immediately; no decorative interpolation masks transitions.
concepts.rationale: Faithful to the recovered source and keeps editing and learning visible together.

concepts.medium: DOM specimen diagrams rendered as individual printed cards.
concepts.composition: A vertical collection of separate prepared experiments and detail screens.
concepts.interaction: Choose a prepared card and then edit it in a secondary experiment view.
concepts.motion: Cards slide into a magnified inspector and return to the collection.
concepts.rationale: Useful for a future library, but adds navigation before the current editor.

concepts.medium: WebGL raised laboratory tray with physical-looking colony markers.
concepts.composition: A circular free-camera dish surrounded by in-world instrument controls.
concepts.interaction: Orbit and zoom the dish, then place markers in a projected 3D field.
concepts.motion: Camera inertia and elastic colony settling give continuous physical movement.
concepts.rationale: Expressive but projection makes exact cell manipulation harder on phones.

selection.reason: The user asked to retain the existing project. Its cell editor and learning loop remain clear with a fitted Canvas bench.

rejected.reason: A card library would introduce another navigation layer before the existing primary edit-and-step workflow.
A 3D camera would obscure discrete coordinates and add rendering cost to an otherwise small offline editor.

tools.reason: Canvas rendering ran in Chromium and the local SVG icon was inspected through the app.

assets.role: Install identity depicts the simulation as a culture dish with a blue agent and green target.
assets.acceptance: Readable blue square and green destination remain distinct at app icon scale.
assets.integration: Manifest and page icon both reference the authored SVG dish.
assets.provenance: Hand-authored vector geometry for this port; no external illustration was copied.

risks: Tool strip must remain reachable on narrow portrait screens.
CSS fitting must preserve pointer-to-cell mapping.
